primary_contrast: Mean held-out hallucination score: trait SFT minus normal SFT
evaluation: Original 20 hallucinating evaluation questions; fixed repeats, sampling seeds, temperature 1 and token cap for every arm
uncertainty: Question-paired bootstrap; one training seed, conditional uncertainty only
hypothesis: Hallucination II SFT increases held-out hallucination relative to Normal SFT
not_tested: Incremental prediction beyond text; robustness across training seeds; calibrated factual accuracy
projection_priority: Only after baseline and both post-SFT evaluations; numerical parity required

deviations: 1024 paired questions per arm sampled from official Normal and Hallucination II datasets, rather than the full datasets; one epoch and one training seed.
Question identity, order, example count and optimizer settings matched; response token totals are measured but not forced equal.
Original rsLoRA rank 32, alpha 64, learning rate 1e-5, effective batch size 16 and response-only loss; standard Transformers/PEFT instead of Unsloth/TRL.
Five stochastic answers for each of 20 official held-out questions (100 per model); same seed schedule and 1000-token cap across all three arms.
Original hallucination/coherence rubrics and logprob aggregation through OpenRouter GPT-4.1-mini alias pinned to OpenAI; exact snapshot equivalence unverified.
Existing reduced-extraction vector reused only after numerical parity passes, and only if time remains after post-SFT evaluation.
No claim of incremental prediction beyond semantic content; source labels define the training contrast.
